policy.defaultAction: model, classify and validate before invoking side-effectful tools
policy.publishRule: GitHub push and iCloud Drive export must be verified separately
policy.cloudRule: Vercel, Supabase and custom server deploys require credentials, explicit target and green gates
policy.secretRule: No provider secrets, tokens or server credentials are stored in git

lanes.label: GitHub source server
lanes.activationCommand: npm run github:preflight && npm run github:publish
lanes.guardrail: Push only the active branch and report remote SHA evidence.

lanes.label: iCloud Drive GitHub export
lanes.guardrail: Create a bundle and share note only after the worktree is clean.

lanes.label: Vercel cloud environment
lanes.activationCommand: npm i -g vercel && vercel pull --environment=preview && vercel env pull .env.local
lanes.guardrail: Do not deploy until .vercel/project.json and provider credentials exist.

lanes.label: Supabase server-only intake
lanes.guardrail: Service role key remains server-only and is never exposed to the browser.

lanes.label: Design and creative connectors
lanes.activationCommand: Use only when a design URL, asset task or explicit creative handoff exists.
lanes.guardrail: Keep assets reviewable and do not overwrite source design systems blindly.

lanes.label: Skills and MCP code intelligence
lanes.activationCommand: npm run collect:mcp-readiness && npm run check:code-automation-plan
lanes.guardrail: Prefer targeted reads and one reversible code improvement per run.

lanes.label: SEO and observability connectors
lanes.activationCommand: Add provider credentials in Vercel or the local shell, then rerun cloud preflight.
lanes.guardrail: Use metrics for clarity and incident safety, not dashboard overload.

lanes.label: New code-writing automation
lanes.guardrail: Commit, push and iCloud export only after targeted checks pass.
